description: Three empty bowls sit on the green tablecloth in front of you: a light mint bowl on the left, a darker teal bowl in the middle, and a pale lavender bowl on the right. The left hand reaches forward to steady the mint bowl while the right hand lifts the teal bowl upward and places it directly on top of the mint bowl, then the right hand picks up the lavender bowl and lowers it onto the stacked pair, releasing it so all three bowls are nested together.
